main_text.l: M. D. XXI ad annum M. D. LX, potestatem

l.i: reliquam magistratus, & politicum regimen
agri non attingant: agrariis liceat separa-
tim suos conventus habere in causis ad
ipsos seorsim sine civitate pertinentibus. Or-
dines hujus provinciæ, Ordines urbis
Groningæ, & Omlandiæ, agrarios solos Omlan-
dios inter Amasum & Lavicam appellare,
rectum sit. Agrarii vectigalia nulla, mer-
catus solennes, trutinas publicas instituant
sine consensu Ordinum provinciæ omnium:
agrariorum postulatum de subdivisione tri-
butorum & onerum inter civitatem &
agrum adhuc non audiatur: interim quod in
onerum modo, quem pro rato provincia hæc
tenetur sustinere, ex tributis & censibus jam
usitatis solvi non potest, id conficiatur ex
quintâ censûs aut proventûs omnium bono-
rum immobilium, agrorum pariter &
adi-ficiorum,

page.notes: The running head "Groningæ" and the æ are read from a small scan and may be slightly off. The final word is split across the line end as "adi-" / "ficiorum," and is joined here as printed. The "O" at the foot is treated as a gathering signature. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout, so "Amasum" and "sustinere" are as set.
